2930662.title: Buan Snow Mullet Festival
2930662.overview: A winter seafood festival in Buan for seol-sungeo — 'snow mullet', at its fattest and sweetest in the cold months — with tastings, market food, fishing-village programs, and local performances.

1762432.title: Yangpyeong Ice & Trout Festival
1762432.overview: Winter fishing at Sumi Village — a presidential-award-winning farm-stay village east of Seoul: smelt netting, bare-hand trout catching, ice-fishing spots, plus pizza and steamed-bun making, succulent crafts, and ATV rides.

3566596.title: Good Neighbors World Play Festival
3566596.overview: A children's-rights NGO festival where kids play traditional games from around the world — earning a world-education certificate — with magic, bubble shows, and balloon art at Pohang's sports center.

3345610.title: Busan International Children's Book Fair
3345610.overview: Korea's first international children's book fair at BEXCO — a picture-book platform gathering publishers, authors, and illustrators from across Asia, and a book festival for kids (elementary age and under enter free).

1139979.title: Nonsan Yangchon Dried Persimmon Festival
1139979.overview: Sweet gotgam (dried persimmon) meets Christmas warmth in Yangchon, one of Korea's dried-persimmon heartlands: some 20 farms selling the winter delicacy with family programs, performances, and markets.

2785797.title: Winter Lights of Cheonggyecheon
2785797.overview: Cheonggye Plaza's 11th winter light garden: a golden cake tree centerpiece with fairies, teddy bears, mini trains, and media art along the stream — themed 'a winter where everyone comes together in golden warmth'. Free, evenings through New Year's Eve.

1095732.title: Seoul Lantern Festival
1095732.overview: Seoul's signature lantern festival since 2009: glowing sculpture installations along the Cheonggyecheon stream from Cheonggye Plaza, this year themed 'my light, our dream, Seoul's magic'. Free, nightly till 23:00 — one of the city's classic winter walks.

3073454.title: Seoul Light Gwanghwamun
3073454.overview: Media-art projections on and around Gwanghwamun — the spot where electric light first entered Korea — themed 'Gwanghwa, Breathe with Light': the square's history retold in moving light across the winter evenings.

3069470.title: Romantic Hangang Christmas Market
3069470.overview: Seven days of Christmas market on Ttukseom Hangang Park themed 'winter playground': light-and-tree photo zones, world street food, craft and ornament stalls, daily programs, and special performances on Christmas Eve and Christmas night.

3439947.title: Gangnam Media Winter Festa
3439947.overview: Media art at Samseong Station's trade-center plaza bridging the holidays: a Korean-reinterpreted K-Christmas show through December 25, then a new-year show welcoming 2026's year of the red horse, with four hands-on programs alongside.

3434800.title: Oncheoncheon Light Festival
3434800.overview: Busan Dongnae's stream glows for 45 winter nights: 1.1km of light sculptures across six themed zones ('Love Song of Oncheoncheon'), with an artificial-snow plaza, busking, and media wish-writing near Dongnae Station.

2802702.title: Pocheon Baegun Valley Jack Frost Festival
2802702.overview: A 65-day winter festival an hour from Seoul: snow and ice sledding, children's rides, ice and indoor fishing, and a giant ice-tree photo zone against Baegun Valley's snowscape — mostly on land, so small kids manage fine. Entry 3,000 won with a 2,000-won food voucher back.

2802077.title: Science Gifted Education Festival
2802077.overview: An education conference sharing research by Korea's gifted-science students and policy results from all 17 provincial education offices, themed 'science talents light the AX era'. Free, open to anyone interested in gifted education.

3067459.title: Daecheon Winter Sea Love Festival
3067459.overview: The mud-festival beach in winter mode: light installations over Daecheon's night sea with couple- and family-oriented programs at the Mud Theme Park, themed sea, light, and love.

2933428.title: Ulsan Seongnam-dong Snow Festival
2933428.overview: Ulsan's downtown winter festival: snowman making, a tree forest, artificial snowfall, a Christmas choir contest, and local stages with flea markets and food zones through the young-street district.

141375.title: Ulju Ganjeolgot Sunrise Festival
141375.overview: Ganjeolgot is where the sun first rises on the Korean peninsula each new year, and the point marks it with a year-end concert on December 31 followed by dawn fireworks and a drone show as 2026's first light breaks over the East Sea.

674023.title: Gangneung New Year Sunrise Festival
674023.overview: Korea's most famous sunrise spots — Gyeongpo Beach and the Jeongdongjin Hourglass Park — host year-end and first-sunrise gatherings, with countdown events through midnight and dawn programs on New Year's morning.

3049823.title: Winter in Yangpyeong: Light & Love
3049823.overview: The highlight night of Yangpyeong's two-month winter stamp-tour festival: fireworks, guest singers, light installations, and market booths on the Namhangang Terrace by the county office on New Year's Eve.

2642299.title: Jeonju New Year's Eve Festival
2642299.overview: Jeonju closes the year with Joseon-pop and gugak crossover stages, b-boy performances, winter ballads, family programs, a midnight drum ceremony, and fireworks at the plaza by city hall.

2702333.title: Countdown Busan
2702333.overview: Busan's New Year countdown on Gwangalli Beach: concerts, a large-scale drone show over the water, and the midnight countdown against the lit Gwangan Bridge — the city's signature year-crossing party.

1506389.title: Gamaksan Sunrise Gathering
1506389.overview: The 27th New Year sunrise gathering on Gamaksan's summit in Geochang: pungmul drumming, wish-gourd breaking, and free tteokguk (rice-cake soup) as the year's first light comes up over the ridges.

3420072.title: Sunyang Barebody Marathon
3420072.overview: Korea's coldest New Year tradition: a shirtless run through Daejeon's Expo Science Park on January 1, held since 2015 to start the year with health and grit — with events and special prizes to warm things up.

2630385.title: Korea Grand Sale 2026
2630385.overview: Korea's national winter shopping-and-culture festival for international visitors: discounts and perks across flights, hotels, beauty, food, and entertainment nationwide, with a welcome center in Myeong-dong offering travel services and events. Registration free at koreagrandsale.co.kr.
2630385.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

3075387.title: Yeongyang Frozen Winter Festival
3075387.overview: A classic Korean winter festival on the frozen Banbyeoncheon in Yeongyang — one of Korea's most remote, star-dark counties: natural ice rink, ice sledding and trains, snow-sled hills, and smelt ice fishing.

1769697.title: Hongcheon River Ice Festival
1769697.overview: Hongcheon's January classic: ice-hole fishing for ginseng-fed trout (a local specialty), bare-hand trout catching, indoor family fishing, ice sledding, folk games, and thatched-village food streets along the frozen river.

1765272.title: Anseong Dongmakgol Smelt Festival
1765272.overview: Ice fishing for bingeo (pond smelt) on Gwanghyewon Reservoir — a clean class-1 valley reservoir in Anseong ringed by hills. A straightforward, family-friendly winter fishing day out.

409187.title: Hongseong Namdang Port Cockle Festival
409187.overview: Saejogae — the plump, sweet 'bird clam' — peaks in winter on the Cheonsuman Bay, and Namdang Port's restaurant row runs a whole season around it: shabu-style cockle pots by the harbor from December through the cold months.

4001390.title: Danyang Winter Play Festival
4001390.overview: Old-fashioned winter play in snowy Danyang: ice sleds and one-blade sleds, ice tug-of-war, yut games, jwibulnori fire-can spinning, nakhwa fire-flower displays, campfire zones, and winter snacks by the Jungnyeong stream.

2362516.title: Haman Dried Persimmon Festival
2362516.overview: Haman gotgam — once royal tribute, made from the small but intensely sweet susi persimmon dried in the winter winds of old Aragaya — stars in a market festival whose highlight is a rollicking national singing contest.

4001518.title: Muan Winter Mullet Festival
4001518.overview: Winter mullet at its best on Muan's mudflat coast: a seafood-market festival at Haeje with local farm-and-sea products, linked to the Hwangto Mudflat Land attractions nearby.

650690.title: Yeongdong Dried Persimmon Festival
650690.overview: Yeongdong's winter market festival for its famous gotgam: sales halls with the county's forest and farm products, roasted chestnuts and sweet potatoes, garaetteok grilling, warm dome lounges, and family winter play by the Yeongdong stream.

1892201.title: Uljin Snow Crab & Red Snow Crab Festival
1892201.overview: Uljin's Hupo Port — one of Korea's snow-crab capitals — throws its winter crab festival at Wangdolcho Plaza: crab markets and meals, auctions, performances, and harbor programs at the source of the famous daege.

292950.title: Gossaum Nori Festival
292950.overview: A full-moon festival for gossaum — the national-heritage 'go fight', where villages ram giant straw loops in a contest of strength dating to Korea's farming past — with mass rope games and torch processions at the tradition's home village in Gwangju.

3472311.title: Yangyang Naksan Beach Moonlight Bonfire Festival
3472311.overview: Bonfires on the winter sand of Naksan Beach: wave sounds, crackling logs, and quiet conversation instead of stages and crowds — a contemplative seaside evening capped by the moon over the East Sea. Reserve via the GoGo Yangyang app (10,000 won).

4025523.title: Jeongseon Buckwheat Crepe Festival
4025523.overview: A food festival at the famous Jeongseon Arirang Market for memil jeonbyeong — the buckwheat crepes of Gangwon's mountain kitchens: griddle demonstrations, master classes, new-menu showcases, and market stalls.

3482014.title: Jecheon Red Odeng Festival
3482014.overview: Jecheon's beloved street snack — fish cakes simmered in a fiery red broth — gets its own festival: 25 pojangmacha tents serving red odeng and variations, an eating contest, magic and bubble shows, and concerts by the station plaza.

1895366.title: 1919 Seodaemun: The Cry of That Day
1895366.overview: March First Independence Movement commemorations at the very sites of 1919: a memorial ceremony, mansei march reenactment, and programs at Seodaemun Independence Park and the former Seodaemun Prison where independence activists were held.
1895366.place: Seodaemun Independence Park and Prison History Hall

3479057.title: Wanju Samnye Strawberry Festival
3479057.overview: Strawberry season in Samnye, Wanju's berry heartland: picking experiences, strawberry desserts and processed goods, local food booths, and family programs — sweet, cheap, and twenty minutes from Jeonju.

667418.title: Jeju Fire Festival
667418.overview: Jeju's most spectacular tradition: the slopes of Saebyeol Oreum set alight in a controlled burn that recalls the island's old pasture-burning custom. Preliminary days bring wish-writing and giant moon-house building; the main weekend delivers theme performances and the night the hill burns. One of Korea's great fire spectacles.

4013337.title: Clipper Race Port Week Tongyeong
4013337.overview: The Clipper Round the World Yacht Race makes its first-ever Korean stopover in Tongyeong: a week of departure ceremonies, marine parades, yacht tours, and RC sailing, plus the Port Table food sessions with chef Kang Leo cooking Tongyeong seafood, fringe stages, and a jazz orchestra night.
4013337.sponsor: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries · Tongyeong City

4062064.title: Comma: Empty, Stay, Fill (Choi Young-wook)
4062064.overview: A retrospective of painter Choi Young-wook's 'Karma' series at the OAR Museum in Gyeongju — moon-jar canvases whose hairline craquelure traces meetings, partings, and reconnections across a life. Four sections follow 30 years of the artist's practice.

968157.title: Sansuyu Village Flower Festival (Uiseong)
968157.overview: Thirty thousand cornelian-cherry trees — many over 300 years old — turn Hwajeon-ri gold each March in Korea's largest sansuyu grove. The 20-ri flower road pairs yellow blossoms against green garlic fields, a painterly early-spring walk in quiet Uiseong.

141641.title: Seocheon Camellia & Webfoot Octopus Festival
141641.overview: Two spring arrivals at once: camellias blooming at Dongbaekjeong and jjukkumi (webfoot octopus) hitting peak season at Maryangjin Port. Children's octopus fishing and boat-fishing experiences anchor the food-and-flowers weekend.

4041281.title: Sasang Garo Park Cherry Blossom Night Market
4041281.overview: Cherry blossoms over open-air drinking tables: Busan Sasang's alley merchants set up a blossom-canopied night market with signature menus, cold beer, indie bands, tap dance, and payback coupon events for three spring evenings.

4033475.title: DMZ World Literature Festa
4033475.overview: Writers from around the world gather inside the DMZ at Camp Greaves — the former US base turned peace space — to talk literature against war, conflict, and hatred: three days of dialogue on democracy and peace at the world's last divided frontier, with sessions in Paju Book City.
4033475.place: Camp Greaves (DMZ) and Paju Book City
4033475.sponsor: Gyeonggi Province · Gyeonggi Cultural Foundation · Writers Association of Korea

3485678.title: Yeonsu Spring Harmony Festival
3485678.overview: The first spring festival at Incheon's new Yeonsu Hanmaeum Park: open lawn, arts programs, and neighborhood stages under the theme 'facing spring' — a fresh community green breaking in its first season.

3483210.title: Gunsan Eunpa Cherry Blossom Night Market
3483210.overview: Cherry blossom season around Eunpa Lake — Gunsan's beloved lakeside walk — revived as a night market after the old blossom festival ended: food stalls, participatory programs, and night-tour content under the petals.

3496655.title: Incheon Open Port Festa: 1901 Live Road
3496655.overview: A street-music festival in the district where Western music first entered Korea: jazz, folk, rock, and EDM across the open-port quarter — Sangsang Platform, the Jemulpo Club, and heritage houses — headlined by major Korean bands (past lineups: Guckkasten, Crying Nut, QWER). All free.
3496655.place: Sangsang Platform and Open Port district

3110031.title: Gurye 300-ri Cherry Blossom Festival
3110031.overview: A 129-kilometer ribbon of cherry blossoms follows the Seomjin River and the skirts of Jirisan through Gurye, linking Hwaeomsa Temple, Sasung-am, and the county's spring villages. The festival adds stages, family games — including a spacing-out contest — and food to the region's most scenic blossom drive.

921281.title: Seogwipo Canola Flower International Walking Festival
921281.overview: The 28th spring walking festival through Seogwipo's canola-yellow fields: 5km, 10km, and 20km courses from the World Cup Stadium, free entry with finisher certificates, QR check-ins, and GPS course guidance — a walker's way into Jeju spring.

3512510.title: Gyeonggi Imagine Spring Festa
3512510.overview: A spring culture festa at the Sangsang Campus in Suwon: talk concerts with star history lecturer Choi Tae-seong and science communicator Gwedo, busking and magic stages, spring photo zones, upcycling and flower-seed crafts — plus an MBC music-show live recording on opening day.

2540520.title: Yangjaecheon Cherry Blossom Lantern Festival
2540520.overview: Blossoms by day, lanterns by night along the Yangjaecheon stream: the 8th edition pairs the cherry-tree walk between Yeongdong bridges with lighting ceremonies, performances, guided tours, and food zones.

4039258.title: Korea Young Farmers National Convention
4039258.overview: The 20th national gathering of Korea's young farmer association at Saebyeol Oreum on Jeju — networking, policy exchange, and public programs on the future of Korean agriculture.

999659.title: Cheongsando Slow Walking Festival
999659.overview: Cheongsando — Asia's first designated Slow City — opens spring with a walking festival along its 42.195km slow road: stone-walled lanes, canola fields, and terraced paddies over a blue sea, with moonlight night walks and healing programs. Ferry from Wando; worth an overnight.

3489505.title: Marine Leisure Tourism Expo 2026
3489505.overview: A 300-booth national expo on marine leisure at Songdo Convensia: equipment, tourism content, and coastal-region showcases with trials and seminars, run by the oceans ministry.
